The '''''Reciprocity''''' was a [[Axehead frigate]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] following the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].

==History==
It was [[Saul Karath]]'s first command, and the first bridge appointment of [[Dallan Morvis]].<ref name="KOTORH" />

[[File:Hammerhead_frigate_KOTOR_W.png|thumb|left|200px|The ''Reciprocity'' at the [[Essien landing]].]]

During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], Morvis returned to captain the ''Reciprocity'', landing [[Phaeda Militia]] troops and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] onto [[Essien]] to battle [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]].
Morvis and his soldiers were tricked into leaving the ship behind and cornered by the Jedi, who turned out to be [[Mandalorian Knights]]. They meant to take the vessel and use it against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], forcefully drafting the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and his crew.<ref name="KOTOR-W1" />

Later Morvis, with the help of [[Zayne Carrick]], not only took his ship back, but used it to save the Jedi [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|younglings]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], foiling the plan of [[Dorjander Kace]].

After those events, Morvis was considered a hero, he took the helm of his ship, and continued his career with a new viewpoint, a more diplomatic approach, and a new conscience in the person of Zayne Carrick.
